parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['product_name','target_persona','key_actions','sequence_length_days'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const keyActions=Array.isArray(body.key_actions)?body.key_actions:(body.key_actions||'').split('\n').map(a=>a.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(keyActions.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'key_actions must define at least one activation action'}}];const lengthDays=Math.min(60,Math.max(3,parseInt(body.sequence_length_days)||14));return[{json:{valid:true,productName:body.product_name.trim(),productDescription:(body.product_description||'').slice(0,400),targetPersona:body.target_persona.trim().slice(0,300),keyActions:keyActions.slice(0,8),activationGoal:(body.activation_goal||'complete core setup').slice(0,200),sequenceLengthDays:lengthDays,emailsInSequence:Math.min(10,Math.max(3,parseInt(body.emails_in_sequence)||5)),tone:body.tone||'helpful_and_direct',commonDropoffReasons:(body.common_dropoff_reasons||'').slice(0,400),existingEngagementData:(body.existing_engagement_data||'').slice(0,400),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You design onboarding email sequences for SaaS products. Good onboarding emails: focus on one action per email; use social proof and concrete outcomes rather than feature lists; arrive at the right time (not all on day 1); have subject lines that earn the open; don't sound like marketing. The goal is to get the user to their first value moment, not to showcase every feature. Always respond in valid JSON only.
